Example longitudinal antibody data

Source: R/data.R
example_longitudinal_antibody_data.Rd

Example antibody data for a longitudinal study design, generated by simulate_data. The data contain repeated samples from the same individuals over time and use one biomarker group.

data(example_longitudinal_antibody_data)

Format

A data frame with 500 rows (each corresponding to an antibody measurement) and 7 variables: `individual`, `sample_time`, `birth`, `repeat_number`, `biomarker_id`, `biomarker_group`, and `measurement`.

See also

Other example_data: example_antibody_data, example_antigenic_map, example_inf_chain, example_inf_hist, example_multiple_biomarker_groups_data, example_par_tab, example_theta_chain
